notes: The served counts match Table 3, primary outcome AAD - Abx+30d. The table columns are outcome, total number with values, LcS group, Placebo group, then risk estimates: 45% (59 / 131) belongs to LcS and 42.1% (53 /126) to placebo. The shared count spans preserve the raw XML row; arm names occur in the separate column headers. These are participants with AAD, not the separately reported number of diarrhoea episodes. The primary analysis includes available end-point data: Table 3 reports 257 with values and 102 missing (28.4%). Randomised totals were 181 LcS and 178 placebo, not the analysed denominators 131 and 126. The abstract describes the primary window as after finishing LcS/placebo; the methods and Table 3 specify after the antibiotic course, which is the window extracted here. No registry arm mapping is available in the packet.
